logo: The logo in the header and the footer, and the logo search engines read. Replace it with an SVG of the same shape.
logo_inverse: For a see-through header over a dark picture. The site doesn't use one: leave it empty.
logo_height: Height of the header logo on large screens. The footer logo has its own height.
logo_height_mobile: Height of the header logo on phones. The logo, call button and menu button must still fit on one line.
favicon: The small icon in the browser tab, shown at 32 × 32 pixels. Use a square image.
